recipe.visualDefinition: A split-screen composition featuring a portrait of a male performer in tropical attire on the left and a vertical stack of vibrant, rounded-corner text blocks framed by a stylized film strip on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the left looks directly at the viewer, balancing the heavy graphic weight on the right.
The vertical film strip acts as a structural spine separating the photographic and graphic halves.
Repetition of rounded rectangular containers creates a rhythmic vertical hierarchy.
Color coordination between the subject's shirt and the graphic background elements.
coreInvariants: Rounded rectangular text boxes in high-contrast colors
Split-screen 60/40 ratio between image and graphics

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait occupying the left 60% of the frame, slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, yellow-outlined name in the pink box serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the boldest text box, then travels down the vertical stack of graphics.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with information and pattern.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep magenta and bright yellow for the graphic containers.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white film strip border providing structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and teal used for secondary text and small badge elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value contrast typical of early 1960s color printing.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to primary and secondary CMYK-adjacent colors

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical compression for display text
Heavy black outlines on bright-colored glyphs
Italicized and staggered baselines for secondary titles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are tightly tracked with overlapping outlines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking contrasting weights of sans-serifs within distinct color blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed display feel of the primary name.
Captures the mid-century commercial sans-serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a 1950s pompadour hairstyle wearing a patterned aloha shirt and a white flower lei, holding a small ukulele. The background should be a soft blue gradient. Leave the right 40% of the frame for a vertical black strip with white square sprocket holes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four rounded-corner rectangles in a vertical stack on the right: yellow, pink, yellow, and magenta. Place bold, condensed, outlined sans-serif text inside each, using high-contrast colors like yellow on pink and cyan on yellow.

verificationChecks: Is the film strip border present?
Are the text boxes rounded rectangles?
Is the color palette vibrant and saturated?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the text boxes
Number of text boxes in the stack
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the film strip does not look like modern digital film icons.
Verify the text is legible against the bright background colors.
Check that the subject's pose feels like a studio publicity shot.
Confirm the rounded corners of the boxes are consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on left + Film strip spine + Stacked color-block typography on right.
